title: Inconsistent error message detail in whois() vs status()
description: The whois() method uses abbreviated error context ('connect:', 'send:', 'parse:') while status() uses fuller descriptions ('connect to tailscaled socket:', 'HTTP/1.1 handshake:'). This inconsistency can confuse new contributors about error reporting style. Additionally, line 206 'WhoIs response too large' omits the byte count, making production diagnosis harder. Suggest standardizing on the more verbose style and including actual/limit in all size-limit errors.
